SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Neemrana. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory and dispatch it fitted ? walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done ? to the RIICO Industrial Area, the Ghiloth belt and the Japanese-zone plants along the Delhi?Jaipur highway. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Container Office Manufacturer for Neemrana Japanese Zone range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands ? no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. In a fast-growing auto and engineering hub like Neemrana, that lets a new plant or a contractor set up an admin office, a QC room or a site cabin without holding up the project.

Who buys a container office in Neemrana

Neemrana is one of North India's strongest industrial corridors, anchored by the RIICO estate and the Japanese investment zone. Most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Auto-component and engineering units needing an admin, QC or supervisor office on site
  • Japanese-zone and RIICO plants needing a clean, insulated cabin during setup or expansion
  • EPC and civil contractors needing a temporary site office for a plant project
  • Units needing a gate and security office at the plot entrance

Every unit we supply is an administrative or site cabin ? a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as process, paint-shop or hazardous-area structures.

Where we deliver in and around Neemrana

We supply container offices across the main industrial pockets of the Neemrana belt:

  • RIICO Industrial Area, Neemrana ? 301705
  • Neemrana Japanese Zone, within the RIICO estate ? 301705
  • Ghiloth Industrial Area ? 301705
  • Neemrana town and the institutional area ? 301705

This corridor runs on auto components, precision engineering and light manufacturing ? buyers who often need a clean office added quickly beside a working line. Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Neemrana site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point ? a 10 ft cabin
  • An admin, QC or supervisor office ? a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area ? a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A plant on a planned estate plot ? a prefabricated container office for RIICO estate plots

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftAdmin, QC or supervisor officeMost common for plant units
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation, since we build to order rather than from stock.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Neemrana is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your unit works. Common additions for Neemrana sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Greater Noida factory

Neemrana is served from our Greater Noida factory on North-zone dispatch. The road route runs via Gurgaon and Bhiwadi on NH48 into Neemrana ? roughly 140?160 km depending on your plot. Transit is typically within our standard 3?5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ?3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the wider corridor? See our Jaipur container office builds, container offices we cover across Delhi NCR, and container offices we supply toward the Meerut belt.

Documentation for vendor onboarding

Auto and engineering units in Neemrana, especially in the Japanese zone, expect clean paperwork. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 09ABBCS7101B1ZT) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration. This keeps procurement and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1?2 years on finishing, with a 20?25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Neemrana

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Neemrana. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote ? no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Neemrana?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Neemrana site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to the RIICO estate, Ghiloth and the Japanese zone?

Yes. We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory via Gurgaon and Bhiwadi on NH48 to the RIICO Industrial Area, the Neemrana Japanese Zone, Ghiloth Industrial Area and Neemrana town (301705) ? about 140?160 km. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

Which size suits an auto-component plant admin or QC office?

A 20 ft cabin covers most admin, QC and supervisor needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and e-way bill for vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your container office in Neemrana, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
